يستقضوا (form X)
# يَسْتَقْضُوا (yastaqḍū) /jas.taq.dˤuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْضَى (istaqḍā)
# يُسْتَقْضَوْا (yustaqḍaw) /jus.taq.dˤaw/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْضَى (istaqḍā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
